name: Saldaña de Burgos (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes, green, white and red in the proportions 3:4:3, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Saldaña de Burgos (tierced with a crozier and sword, a cross and a fleur-de-lis).
history: The arms and the flag were approved by the Diputación Provincial de Burgos on 8 February 2001 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 28 February 2001; the flag is square, composed of three vertical stripes, green, white and red, of widths 3-4-3, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Saldaña de Burgos arms — tierced with crozier and sword, cross and fleur-de-lis
